objective: Allow local agents to exchange immutable snapshots and typed research signals continuously without mutating production weights, verdicts, or trades.
current_behavior: AgentDirector runs a three-level cascade synchronously.
Agent state is persisted independently by individual agents.
constraints: Research-only signals; no automatic production mutation.
Preserve evidence class, timestamp, provider/model lineage, and dissent.
Fixed-24m OOS and human review remain promotion gates.
success_metrics: Events can be appended and replayed deterministically.
Each event has an immutable hash chain and safety flags.
Agent Director can publish one snapshot and typed signals without changing its existing return contract.
Invalid or unsafe events are rejected.
Focused and full regression tests remain green apart from documented pre-existing state-dependent failures.
